summary: xAI released a free Grok add-in for Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel that lets users generate, research and edit documents using Grok directly within Office apps.

practices.reason: Adding a Grok add-in to Word/PowerPoint/Excel via the Microsoft Marketplace is a new integration surface but creates no mandatory work for engineering teams building on the models.
practices.quote: Grok for Word is a free Microsoft 365 add-in. Add it from the Microsoft Marketplace , and work directly with Grok in your documents.
